gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-duru-sans: Heavy letters stand apart like beads on a rod, each one alone. Duru Sans brings wide openings and bodies that fill the line, so the sans-serif text feels modern and clean beside that weight.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-fresca: Impact Label stacks heavy, separate letters with a high-set x-height and pincer-like c shapes. And Fresca draws a single-weight line like a plotter pen, keeping its counters connected to the outside in a plain sans way.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-funnel-sans: Each Impact Label letter sits alone like a bead on a rod, heavy and commanding. Funnel Sans is the opposite in temperament, with stroke widths that hold from stem to curve and a lowercase e pried wide open.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-gafata: Gafata runs a tall band of lowercase under short stalks, with each e looking wide-eyed and contemporary. Impact Label hits much harder above it.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-geist: Geist moves in a quiet, level beat, its words forming solid blocks instead of skylines. But Impact Label does the loud work of heavy, separate letters, while the plain sans simply holds the line without any accents of weight.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-georama: Loud meets friendly here. Impact Label delivers heavy, bead-like letters with pincer c shapes, and Georama answers by pulling its c open like a bracelet, a plain sans with barely rising capitals.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-gidole: Gidole reads like neon tube, every stroke drawn alike. Impact Label is the one that hits hard, with its heavy letters standing alone, while the sans keeps scissor-blade terminals apart and its midline high.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-golos-text: Impact Label sets heavy, commanding letters apart like beads on a rod, each c pointing its ends away from the other. Golos Text fills the line with a big x-height and a widely parted s.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-hedvig-letter: Letters that stand alone like beads on a rod, heavy and commanding, define Impact Label, with c ends pointing apart. Hedvig Letters Sans sets small letters nearly as tall as capitals, a plain sans with a clear gap in each c.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-heebo: Impact Label is heavy and commanding, its separate letters strung like beads on a rod. And that weight earns its keep when the text is big and short, while Heebo, a sans-serif with a tall central band, backs it up.
